/* V8 — Battle-first visual refresh */
:root{--mint:#79ffca;--blue:#8fdcff}
html,body{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 0%,#153952,#08111f 54%,#070e19);}
.panel{border-color:#3a6476;box-shadow:0 18px 55px #0007}
.gymHero{background:radial-gradient(circle at 80% 12%,var(--accent,#466d79) 0%,transparent 49%),linear-gradient(135deg,#24445a,#10283b);}
.gymHero h2{text-shadow:0 3px 19px #060f26}
.btn.primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#60f3cf,#20aaab);border-color:#abffde;box-shadow:0 5px 24px #10c9a02b,0 3px 0 #092423}
.brand strong{font-size:clamp(18px,4vw,27px)}
.gymHero .medal{filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 20px #0008)}
.modalBackdrop:has(.combatModal){align-items:center;z-index:55;background:#020915f0;padding:6px}
.modal.combatModal{width:min(99vw,930px);height:auto;max-height:calc(100dvh - 12px);overflow-y:auto;scrollbar-width:thin;overscroll-behavior:contain;padding:13px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 60% 0%,#18354d,#0b1525 70%);border:1px solid #6991a7;border-radius:17px}
.battleHeading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:0 4px 5px}
.battleHeading h2{font-size:clamp(15px,3.8vw,21px);line-height:1.15;margin:5px 0;color:#f9f5e9}
.battleHeading .overline{font-size:10px}
.liveFlag{font-size:10px;color:#93f8c8;letter-spacing:.09em;font-weight:850;border:1px solid #3c8f82;border-radius:99px;padding:7px 9px;white-space:nowrap;background:#14362f}
.liveFlag>span{display:inline-block;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#6ffbc4;box-shadow:0 0 9px #86ffca;vertical-align:1px;margin-right:5px}
.arenaPro{position:relative;width:100%;height:clamp(245px,49dvh,510px);border:2px solid #5d91a2;border-radius:17px;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;box-shadow:0 12px 36px #010815ae,inset 0 0 40px #021322;touch-action:none;background:#163d55}
#battleCanvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;touch-action:none;cursor:crosshair}
.arenaTint{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;box-shadow:inset 0 0 68px #0208159c,inset 0 -25px 45px #0210215e;border-radius:inherit}
.hudPro{position:absolute;top:12px;z-index:4;max-width:44%;width:min(235px,43%);border:1px solid #b1dbde7a;border-radius:11px;padding:9px 10px;background:linear-gradient(125deg,#061622ed,#17304add);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);box-shadow:0 7px 16px #0006}
.hudPro.ally{left:11px}.hudPro.enemy{right:11px;text-align:right}
.hudName{font-weight:950;font-size:clamp(10px,2.8vw,15px);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:5px;color:#fff}.hudPro.enemy .hudName{justify-content:flex-end;gap:9px}
.hudName em{font-size:10px;font-style:normal;color:#bcd9e5;white-space:nowrap}
.hudTrack{height:10px;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;background:#060e1d;border:1px solid #6a8da0;margin:7px 0 3px}
.hudTrack>i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#2de6a1,#b0ffb7);transition:width .17s linear}
.hudNumbers{font-size:10px;color:#dcf8f1;font-weight:750}
.arenaChip{position:absolute;top:86px;left:12px;z-index:2;color:#c0ecdd;background:#102c36b5;padding:5px 9px;border-radius:20px;font-weight:850;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.04em;pointer-events:none}
.crosshairHelp{position:absolute;bottom:13px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:9px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#d6f4f5aa;white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none;max-width:47%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;text-align:center}
.joyZone{position:absolute;bottom:7px;left:10px;z-index:5;width:108px;height:108px;display:grid;place-items:center;touch-action:none;user-select:none;cursor:grab}
.joyBase{width:91px;height:91px;border:2px solid #d3ffff78;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,#c2ecff2b,#04182681);display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:inset 0 0 14px #d9ffff24,0 3px 16px #0004;pointer-events:none}
.joyKnob{width:39px;height:39px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #d4ffffbd;background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 25%,#a2ffdcdd,#27747da8);box-shadow:0 0 16px #99e9f47c;pointer-events:none;will-change:transform}
.dodgeBtn{position:absolute;bottom:16px;right:14px;z-index:5;width:84px;height:84px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #f7ebbadc;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 18%,#f0d281,#926b50 70%,#4a3d37);box-shadow:0 8px 18px #0009,0 0 20px #d7c17b33;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:29px;line-height:1;color:#fff5e4;touch-action:manipulation}
.dodgeBtn small{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.06em;font-weight:900;margin-top:4px}
.dodgeBtn:disabled{filter:grayscale(.9);opacity:.64}
.battleFooter{margin-top:7px}
.energyHud{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:5px 3px;font-size:10px;color:#a8ffdc;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:.04em}
.energyHud span{white-space:nowrap}.energyHud #guardStatus{color:#c7d6e7;font-size:9px;text-align:right}
.energyTrack{flex:1;height:9px;background:#071324;border:1px solid #407b84;border-radius:50px;overflow:hidden}
.energyTrack i{height:100%;display:block;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#59d2ef,#96ffe1);border-radius:50px;transition:width .12s linear}
.skillgridV8{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px;margin:7px 0 8px}
.skillV8{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:11px 12px;min-height:74px;border-radius:15px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#20364d,#0d1d30 65%);border:1px solid #5e82a4;border-left:5px solid var(--skillColor);overflow:hidden;text-align:left;box-shadow:inset 0 1px #ffffff18,0 8px 18px #06132166;isolation:isolate;transition:transform .12s ease,box-shadow .12s ease,border-color .12s ease}
.skillV8::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(120deg,transparent 0 48%,#ffffff10 56%,transparent 64%);opacity:.45;pointer-events:none}
.skillV8:disabled{opacity:.88;color:#d9e0e7}.skillV8:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(2px)}.skillV8:not(:disabled):hover{box-shadow:inset 0 1px #ffffff1f,0 10px 22px #06132188;border-color:#89b6d9}.skillAura{position:absolute;inset:-22% auto auto -8%;width:88px;height:88px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--skillColor),transparent 70%);opacity:.18;filter:blur(8px);pointer-events:none;z-index:0}.skillV8.kind-beam .skillAura{opacity:.24}.skillV8.kind-shield .skillAura{opacity:.15}
.skillIcon{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;place-items:center;width:42px;min-width:42px;height:42px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 25% 20%,#ffffff38,#13263b85);border:1px solid #ffffff1d;border-radius:12px;color:var(--skillColor);font-size:25px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px var(--skillColor))}
.skillName{position:relative;z-index:1;min-width:0;font-size:clamp(11px,2.5vw,13px);font-weight:950;line-height:1.18;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.skillName b{display:block;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.skillName small{display:block;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:#b8d6e4;margin-top:5px;letter-spacing:.02em}
.skillMeta{position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:4px;white-space:nowrap}.skillMeta b{font-size:12px;color:#f8fff3;background:#0d2236d0;border:1px solid #5c8698;padding:4px 7px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:inset 0 1px #ffffff12}.skillMeta small{font-size:10px;color:#c3d3df;font-weight:800}
.coolMask{position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0 0;height:0;background:#020712bf;pointer-events:none;z-index:2}
.coolText{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:1000;font-size:21px;text-shadow:0 2px 10px #000;z-index:3;pointer-events:none;color:#f0fffc}
.battleActions{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.miniBtn{border:1px solid #4b718c;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#19364b,#112439);border-radius:9px;padding:9px 10px;font-weight:800;font-size:11px;flex:1;min-width:75px}
.miniBtn:disabled{opacity:.4}.miniBtn.catchButton{border-color:#e7a39f;color:#ffdbd4;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#5a353c,#2f2538)}
.battleMessage{padding:8px 12px;min-height:31px;background:#0d2030;border:1px solid #385a77;border-radius:9px;color:#d7f9f0;font-size:12px;font-weight:720;margin-top:7px}
.keyHelp{font-size:10px;text-align:center;color:#83a2b5;padding:4px 0 1px}
.swapSheet{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#081726ef;z-index:10;overflow-y:auto;padding:15px;backdrop-filter:blur(9px)}
.swapSheet .swapgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));margin-top:10px}
.swapSheet .swapgrid button{padding:7px;background:#162a3f}

const D={};SPEC.forEach(([id,name,type,type2,hp,atk,def,spd,evolve,at,icon])=>D[id]={id,name,type,type2,hp,atk,def,spd,evolve,at,icon});

// All Kanto species 1..151 have a route; legendaries / rare creatures are saved for later stages.

function kantoRouteLevel(id){const p=D[id];if(KANTO_LEGENDS.has(id))return 7;if([147,148,149,131,142,143].includes(id))return 5;if(KANTO_RARE.has(id))return 3+id%5;const evol=SPEC.some(e=>e[8]===id);if(evol)return Math.min(6,2+id%5);return id%5;}
const KANTO_ZONES=Array.from({length:8},(_,i)=>Array.from({length:151},(_,k)=>k+1).filter(id=>kantoRouteLevel(id)===i));
const KANTO_SHOP=[{id:'potion',name:'Poção',icon:'🧪',price:20,detail:'Recupera 35% dos PV da equipe'},{id:'super',name:'Superpoção',icon:'💖',price:48,detail:'Recupera 65% dos PV da equipe'},{id:'ball',name:'Pokébola',icon:'🔴',price:12,detail:'Para capturar um Pokémon na grama'}];

];
// Core type effectiveness follows FireRed-style super-effective / resistance chart.
const EFFECT={normal:{rock:.5,ghost:0,steel:.5},fire:{fire:.5,water:.5,grass:2,ice:2,bug:2,rock:.5,dragon:.5,steel:2},water:{fire:2,water:.5,grass:.5,ground:2,rock:2,dragon:.5},grass:{fire:.5,water:2,grass:.5,poison:.5,ground:2,flying:.5,bug:.5,rock:2,dragon:.5,steel:.5},electric:{water:2,electric:.5,grass:.5,ground:0,flying:2,dragon:.5},ice:{fire:.5,water:.5,grass:2,ground:2,flying:2,dragon:2,steel:.5,ice:.5},fighting:{normal:2,ice:2,poison:.5,flying:.5,psychic:.5,bug:.5,rock:2,ghost:0,dark:2,steel:2},poison:{grass:2,poison:.5,ground:.5,rock:.5,ghost:.5,steel:0},ground:{fire:2,electric:2,grass:.5,poison:2,flying:0,bug:.5,rock:2,steel:2},flying:{electric:.5,grass:2,fighting:2,bug:2,rock:.5,steel:.5},psychic:{fighting:2,poison:2,psychic:.5,dark:0,steel:.5},bug:{fire:.5,grass:2,fighting:.5,poison:.5,flying:.5,psychic:2,ghost:.5,dark:2,steel:.5},rock:{fire:2,ice:2,fighting:.5,ground:.5,flying:2,bug:2,steel:.5},ghost:{normal:0,psychic:2,ghost:2,dark:.5},dragon:{dragon:2,steel:.5},dark:{fighting:.5,psychic:2,ghost:2,dark:.5,steel:.5},steel:{fire:.5,water:.5,electric:.5,ice:2,rock:2,steel:.5}};
const advantage=(type,def)=>(EFFECT[type]?.[def.type]??1)*(EFFECT[type]?.[def.type2]??1);
const defaultSave=()=>({v:9,starter:null,team:[],box:[],gym:0,stage:0,routeUsed:{},medals:[],coins:35,balls:5,potions:3,superPotions:0,wins:0,losses:0,seen:[],caught:[]});
let save=defaultSave();try{const s=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY)||localStorage.getItem('pokeTorreKantoV8')||localStorage.getItem('pokeTorreKantoV7')||'null');if((s?.v===7||s?.v===8||s?.v===9)&&Array.isArray(s.team)&&Number.isInteger(s.gym)&&s.gym>=0&&s.gym<=13){save={...defaultSave(),...s};save.team=save.team.filter(m=>D[m.id]&&m.level>=1&&m.level<=100).slice(0,6);save.box=(save.box||[]).filter(m=>D[m.id]).slice(0,100);}}catch{}
save.superPotions=Math.max(0,Number(save.superPotions)||0);save.coins=Math.max(0,Number(save.coins)||0);
if(!Array.isArray(save.seen))save.seen=[];if(!Array.isArray(save.caught))save.caught=[];
for(const m of [...save.team,...save.box]){if(m&&D[m.id]){if(!save.seen.includes(m.id))save.seen.push(m.id);if(!save.caught.includes(m.id))save.caught.push(m.id)}}
function persist(){try{localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY,JSON.stringify(save))}catch{}}
function mon(id,level){const s=D[id],maxHp=Math.round((s.hp*2*level)/100+level+16);return {id,level,xp:0,maxHp,hp:maxHp};}
function img(id,other=''){const p=D[id],slug=V11_SPRITES[id];const local=slug?(V11_EMBEDDED_SPRITES[slug]||`sprites/${slug}.png`):null;
 return `<span class="spritewrap"><span class="placeholder">${p.icon}</span><img class="sprite" style="image-rendering:${local?'pixelated':'auto'}" src="${local||ART+id+'.png'}" alt="${p.name}" loading="lazy" onerror="${local?`this.onerror=()=>this.remove();this.src='${ART}${id}.png'`:'this.remove()'}" ${other}></span>`;
}
function thumb(m){let p=D[m.id];return `<div class="moncard"><div>${img(m.id)}</div><strong>${p.name}</strong><small>Nv. ${m.level}</small><div class="life"><i style="width:${100*m.hp/m.maxHp}%"></i></div><small>${Math.ceil(m.hp)}/${m.maxHp} PV</small></div>`}
function render(){let g=GYMS[Math.min(12,save.gym)]||GYMS[7];$('resources').innerHTML=`<span class="pill">🏅 ${save.medals.length}/8</span><span class="pill">🪙 ${save.coins}</span><span class="pill">🔴 ${save.balls}</span><span class="pill">🧪 ${save.potions}</span><span class="pill">💖 ${save.superPotions}</span>`;if(!save.starter){renderWelcome();return}if(save.gym>=8){v27RenderLeague();return}let step=save.stage,remaining=v29TrainerCount(save.gym)-step;const grassAllowed=step>=1&&step<=v29TrainerCount(save.gym);let routeKey=`${save.gym}-${step}`,used=save.routeUsed[routeKey]||0;let stages=Array.from({length:v29TrainerCount(save.gym)+1},(_,i)=>`<div class="stage ${i<step?'done':i===step?'now':'lock'}"><b>${i<step?'✓':i===v29TrainerCount(save.gym)?g.medal:i+1}</b><small>${i===v29TrainerCount(save.gym)?'LÍDER':'TREINADOR'}</small></div>`).join('');$('main').innerHTML=`<div class="layout"><section class="panel"><div class="gymHero" style="--accent:${g.accent}"><div><div class="overline">GINÁSIO ${save.gym+1} / 8 · ${TYPE_NAME[g.type].toUpperCase()}</div><h2>${g.name}</h2><div class="leader">👑 Líder ${g.leader}</div><div class="meta" style="margin-top:12px"><span>Níveis ${g.min}–${g.max}</span><span>Limite recomendado ${g.levelCap}</span></div></div><div class="medal">${g.medal}</div></div><div class="pad"><div class="sectionhead"><div><div class="overline">PROGRESSO NA TORRE</div><div class="headline">${step===v29TrainerCount(save.gym)?'O LÍDER AGUARDA':`Treinador ${step+1} de ${v29TrainerCount(save.gym)}`}</div><div class="desc">${step===v29TrainerCount(save.gym)?`Vença ${g.leader} para conquistar a insígnia e abrir o próximo ginásio.`:`Derrote os treinadores ${TYPE_NAME[g.type].toLowerCase()} antes de enfrentar o líder. Faltam ${remaining} treinadores.`}</div></div></div><div class="progress"><i style="width:${100*step/(v29TrainerCount(save.gym)+1)}%"></i></div><div class="tower">${stages}</div><div class="actionRow"><button class="btn ${step===v29TrainerCount(save.gym)?'gold':'primary'}" id="fightBtn">${step===v29TrainerCount(save.gym)?'👑 ENFRENTAR O LÍDER':`⚔️ BATALHAR · FASE ${step+1}`}</button><button class="btn ghost" id="teamBtn">🎒 ORGANIZAR EQUIPE</button><button class="btn shopBtn" id="shopBtn">🛍️ LOJA · 🪙 <strong>${save.coins}</strong></button><button class="btn ghost" id="dexBtn">📖 POKÉDEX 151</button></div><div class="grass"><div class="grassIcon">🌾</div><div class="grassText"><b>Grama alta • rota ${save.gym+1}</b><span>${grassAllowed?`151 Pokémon de Kanto distribuídos por regiões, incluindo encontros raros. ${Math.max(0,3-used)} encontro(s) disponíveis nesta parada.`:'A grama aparece após a primeira batalha e em novas paradas da torre.'}</span></div><button class="btn ${grassAllowed?'gold':'ghost'} tiny" id="grassBtn" ${!grassAllowed||used>=3||save.balls<=0?'disabled':''}>🔴 EXPLORAR</button></div><p class="desc" style="margin:15px 0 0">💡 Você começou com um único Pokémon básico. Os demais entram na equipe por captura, e só evoluem quando atingem o nível necessário.</p></div></section><aside class="panel pad"><div class="sectionhead"><div><div class="overline">SEUS PARCEIROS</div><div class="headline">Minha equipe (${save.team.length}/6)</div></div><button class="btn tiny ghost" id="healBtn">🧪 POÇÃO</button></div><div class="teamrow">${save.team.map(thumb).join('')}${Array.from({length:6-save.team.length},()=>`<div class="moncard" style="opacity:.55"><div style="font-size:35px">＋</div><small>Capture na grama</small></div>`).join('')}</div><hr class="divider"><div class="sectionhead"><div><div class="overline">PROGRESSÃO</div><h3 style="margin:5px 0">Próximas insígnias</h3></div></div><div class="meta">${GYMS.map((gy,i)=>`<span style="opacity:${i>save.gym?.45:1};${i===save.gym?'border-color:#eccf77':''}">${save.medals.includes(i)?'✅':gy.medal} ${TYPE_NAME[gy.type]}</span>`).join('')}</div><div style="margin-top:15px" class="notice">Sem seleção de Pokémon evoluídos no início, sem mapa para caminhar. Apenas clicar, batalhar, capturar na grama e construir sua equipe. A V15 reúne os 151 Pokémon de Kanto, loja, Pokédex e mira apenas no adversário.</div></aside></div>`;
$('fightBtn').onclick=()=>launchTrainer();$('teamBtn').onclick=()=>showTeam();$('grassBtn').onclick=()=>grassEncounter();$('healBtn').onclick=()=>showItems();$('shopBtn').onclick=showShop;$('dexBtn').onclick=showPokedex;}
function renderWelcome(){$('main').innerHTML=`<section class="panel pad" style="max-width:680px;margin:6vh auto"><div class="overline">NOVO JOGO · TORRE V35.11 · KANTO EVOLUÍDO</div><div class="headline" style="font-size:32px">Sua jornada começa com uma escolha.</div><p class="desc">Como em Pokémon FireRed, você escolhe <b>um</b> dos três Pokémon iniciais, todos no nível 5 e sem evoluções. Depois, capture novos parceiros na grama alta entre os treinadores. Agora temos os 151 Pokémon de Kanto, sprites animados, loja de moedas, Pokédex e mira automática no adversário — sem golpes desviando para as pedras.</p><div class="choose">${[1,4,7].map(id=>`<button data-starter="${id}">${img(id)}<strong>${D[id].name}</strong><span>${TYPE_NAME[D[id].type]} · Nv. 5</span></button>`).join('')}</div><div class="notice">V25: 151 Pokémon, loja, animações de Pokébola e entrada, chefes especiais, poderes e status com efeitos de verdade. A captura, os iniciais e as evoluções seguem a lógica de FireRed.</div></section>`;document.querySelectorAll('[data-starter]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{let id=+b.dataset.starter;save=defaultSave();save.starter=id;save.team=[mon(id,5)];save.seen=[id];save.caught=[id];persist();render()})}
function renderWin(){$('main').innerHTML=`<section class="panel pad" style="max-width:750px;margin:7vh auto;text-align:center"><div style="font-size:80px">🏆</div><div class="overline">TORRE CONCLUÍDA</div><h1>CAMPEÃO DOS OITO GINÁSIOS!</h1><p class="desc">Você conquistou todas as insígnias, treinou sua equipe e venceu os líderes. Pode continuar revendo sua coleção e iniciar outro desafio.</p><button class="btn primary" id="teamBtn">🎒 VER EQUIPE</button> <button class="btn ghost" id="newBtn">↻ NOVA JORNADA</button></section>`;$('teamBtn').onclick=showTeam;$('newBtn').onclick=()=>confirm('Reiniciar tudo? O progresso atual será apagado.')&&(save=defaultSave(),persist(),render());}
const overlay=(content)=>{$('modal').innerHTML=content;$('backdrop').classList.remove('hide');};function close(){if(battle)return;$('backdrop').classList.add('hide');$('modal').innerHTML=''}
function requireTeam(){return save.team.some(m=>m.hp>0)}
function showTeam(){let all=[...save.team,...save.box];let list=all.map((m,i)=>`<button data-team="${i}">${img(m.id)}<span><b>${D[m.id].name} · Nv. ${m.level}</b><br><small>${TYPE_NAME[D[m.id].type]} · PV ${m.hp}/${m.maxHp} · ${i<save.team.length?'Na equipe':'Na caixa'}</small></span><span class="pillSmall">${i<save.team.length?'EQUIPE':'CAIXA'}</span></button>`).join('');overlay(`<div class="sectionhead"><div><div class="overline">ATÉ 6 NA EQUIPE</div><h2>🎒 Gerenciar Pokémon</h2></div><button class="btn tiny ghost" id="closeModal">✕</button></div><p class="desc">Clique num Pokémon para colocá-lo como primeiro da equipe. Para trocar por Pokémon guardados na caixa, selecione a espécie e o espaço de destino.</p><div class="list">${list||'Nenhum Pokémon.'}</div><hr class="divider"><div class="actionRow"><button class="btn" id="healAll">🧪 CURAR EQUIPE (1 POÇÃO)</button><button class="btn ghost" id="dismiss">VOLTAR</button></div><div class="actionRow" style="margin-top:9px"><button class="btn tiny ghost" id="exportBackup">💾 EXPORTAR SAVE</button><button class="btn tiny ghost" id="importBackup">📂 IMPORTAR SAVE</button></div>`);$('closeModal').onclick=close;$('dismiss').onclick=close;$('healAll').onclick=()=>{healTeam();showTeam()};$('exportBackup').onclick=()=>{const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(save,null,2)],{type:'application/json'}),u=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=u;a.download='pokemon-torre-save.json';document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u),1500)};$('importBackup').onclick=()=>{const i=document.createElement('input');i.type='file';i.accept='.json,application/json';i.onchange=async()=>{try{const value=JSON.parse(await i.files[0].text());if((value.v!==7&&value.v!==8&&value.v!==9)||!Array.isArray(value.team)||!value.team.length||!Number.isInteger(value.gym)||value.gym<0||value.gym>13)throw Error();save={...defaultSave(),...value};save.team=save.team.filter(m=>D[m.id]&&Number.isFinite(m.level)).slice(0,6);save.box=(save.box||[]).filter(m=>D[m.id]).slice(0,100);save.gym=Math.min(13,Math.max(0,save.gym));save.stage=clamp(save.stage||0,0,6);if(!save.team.length)throw Error();persist();render();showTeam()}catch{alert('Arquivo inválido. Selecione um backup da Pokémon Torre V7, V8 ou V9.')}};i.click()};document.querySelectorAll('[data-team]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const i=+b.dataset.team;if(i<save.team.length){[save.team[0],save.team[i]]=[save.team[i],save.team[0]];persist();showTeam()}else{let idx=i-save.team.length;overlay(`<h2>Trocar Pokémon da caixa</h2><p class="desc">Escolha quem vai sair da equipe para entrar ${D[save.box[idx].id].name}.</p><div class="swapgrid">${save.team.map((m,j)=>`<button data-replace="${j}">${img(m.id)}<b>${D[m.id].name}</b></button>`).join('')}</div><button class="btn ghost wide" id="backBox" style="margin-top:15px">VOLTAR</button>`);$('backBox').onclick=showTeam;document.querySelectorAll('[data-replace]').forEach(e=>e.onclick=()=>{let j=+e.dataset.replace;[save.team[j],save.box[idx]]=[save.box[idx],save.team[j]];persist();showTeam()})}})}

function showShop(){overlay(`<div class="sectionhead"><div><div class="overline">MERCADO DA TORRE</div><h2>🛍️ PokéMart</h2></div><button class="btn tiny ghost" id="shopClose">✕</button></div><p class="desc">Ganhe moedas vencendo treinadores e encontros selvagens. Compre suprimentos para continuar subindo a torre.</p><div class="shopBalance">🪙 <strong>${save.coins}</strong> moedas disponíveis</div><div class="shopList">${KANTO_SHOP.map(item=>`<div class="shopItem"><div class="shopEmoji">${item.icon}</div><div class="shopInfo"><strong>${item.name}</strong><small>${item.detail}</small></div><button class="btn ${save.coins>=item.price?'gold':'ghost'} tiny" data-buy="${item.id}" ${save.coins<item.price?'disabled':''}>🪙 ${item.price} · COMPRAR</button></div>`).join('')}</div><p class="desc" style="margin-top:12px">Na equipe: 🧪 ${save.potions} poções · 💖 ${save.superPotions} superpoções · 🔴 ${save.balls} Pokébolas</p><button class="btn ghost wide" id="shopBack" style="margin-top:10px">VOLTAR À TORRE</button>`);$('shopClose').onclick=close;$('shopBack').onclick=close;document.querySelectorAll('[data-buy]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{let item=KANTO_SHOP.find(x=>x.id===b.dataset.buy);if(!item||save.coins<item.price)return;save.coins-=item.price;if(item.id==='potion')save.potions++;if(item.id==='super')save.superPotions++;if(item.id==='ball')save.balls++;persist();render();showShop()});}
function healSuper(){if(!save.superPotions)return;save.superPotions--;for(const m of save.team)m.hp=Math.min(m.maxHp,m.hp+Math.ceil(m.maxHp*.65));persist();render();}
function showPokedex(){const seen=new Set(save.seen||[]),caught=new Set(save.caught||[]);overlay(`<div class="sectionhead"><div><div class="overline">REGIÃO DE KANTO · 001–151</div><h2>📖 Pokédex de Kanto</h2></div><button class="btn tiny ghost" id="pokedexClose">✕</button></div><p class="desc">151 Pokémon disponíveis nas rotas da torre. ${seen.size} vistos · ${caught.size} registrados como capturados. A maioria das artes adicionais usa o SpriteCollab online; os dez sprites originais locais seguem disponíveis sem internet.</p><div class="dexGrid">${Array.from({length:151},(_,index)=>{let id=index+1,p=D[id],known=seen.has(id),owned=caught.has(id);return `<div class="dexCard ${known?'':'dexUnknown'}">${known?img(id):`<div class="dexShadow">?</div>`}<span>#${String(id).padStart(3,'0')}</span><b>${known?p.name:'???'}</b><small>${owned?'✓ CAPTURADO':known?'VISTO':'DESCONHECIDO'}</small></div>`}).join('')}</div><button class="btn ghost wide" id="pokedexBack" style="margin-top:14px">VOLTAR À TORRE</button>`);$('pokedexClose').onclick=close;$('pokedexBack').onclick=close;}

function showItems(){overlay(`<h2>🧪 Centro de recuperação</h2><p class="desc">Poção: recupera 35% dos PV da equipe. Superpoção: recupera 65%. Ganhe moedas vencendo e compre no PokéMart.</p><p class="pill">🪙 ${save.coins} · 🧪 ${save.potions} · 💖 ${save.superPotions}</p><div class="actionRow"><button class="btn primary" id="useHeal" ${save.potions<=0?'disabled':''}>🧪 POÇÃO</button><button class="btn gold" id="superHeal" ${save.superPotions<=0?'disabled':''}>💖 SUPERPOÇÃO</button><button class="btn ghost" id="buyHeal">🛍️ COMPRAR</button><button class="btn ghost" id="backHeal">VOLTAR</button></div>`);$('useHeal').onclick=()=>{healTeam();showItems()};$('superHeal').onclick=()=>{healSuper();showItems()};$('buyHeal').onclick=showShop;$('backHeal').onclick=close}
function healTeam(){if(!save.potions)return;save.potions--;for(const m of save.team)m.hp=Math.min(m.maxHp,m.hp+Math.ceil(m.maxHp*.35));persist();render();}
function teamOfTrainer(g,step){const gym=GYMS[g],level=gym.min+Math.floor(step*1.15),showcase=DETAILED_SHOWCASE[g]||[];if(step===v29TrainerCount(save.gym)){let boss=[...gym.boss];const extra=showcase[showcase.length-1];if(extra&&!boss.includes(extra))boss.push(extra);return boss.map((id,i)=>mon(id,Math.min(70,gym.max-2+i*2)));}let a=[gym.pool[step%gym.pool.length]];if(step>=3)a.push(gym.pool[(step+2)%gym.pool.length]);if(step===5)a.push(gym.pool[(step+4)%gym.pool.length]);if(step>=4&&showcase.length){const extra=showcase[step%showcase.length];if(extra&&!a.includes(extra))a.push(extra);}return a.map((id,i)=>mon(id,Math.min(70,level+i)));}
function launchTrainer(){if(!requireTeam()){showItems();return}let g=save.gym,step=save.stage,queue=teamOfTrainer(g,step);startBattle(queue,step===v29TrainerCount(save.gym)?'👑 LÍDER '+GYMS[g].leader:`⚔️ TREINADOR ${step+1}`,false);}
function grassEncounter(){if(save.balls<=0)return;let key=save.gym+'-'+save.stage,used=save.routeUsed[key]||0;if(save.stage<1||save.stage>=v29TrainerCount(save.gym)+1||used>=3)return;save.routeUsed[key]=used+1;let g=GYMS[save.gym],options=g.wild;let detailed=DETAILED_SHOWCASE[save.gym]||[];let kantoPool=[...KANTO_ZONES[save.gym],...(save.gym>0?KANTO_ZONES[save.gym-1]:[])].filter(id=>id<=151);let chance=Math.random(),pool=chance<.46?kantoPool:chance<.65?detailed:options;if(!pool.length)pool=options;let id=pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)];if(KANTO_LEGENDS.has(id)&&Math.random()<.94)id=pool.filter(x=>!KANTO_LEGENDS.has(x))[Math.floor(Math.random()*Math.max(1,pool.filter(x=>!KANTO_LEGENDS.has(x)).length))]||id;let level=clamp(g.min-2+Math.floor(Math.random()*3)+(pool===detailed?1:0),3,g.levelCap-2);persist();startBattle([mon(id,level)],pool===kantoPool?'🌟 ENCONTRO KANTO':pool===detailed?'✨ ENCONTRO DETALHADO':'🌾 ENCONTRO SELVAGEM',true);}
let battle=null,engine=null,cooldowns=[0,0,0,0],enemyTimer=null,animTimeouts=[];
function stopTimers(){if(engine){engine.destroy();engine=null}if(enemyTimer)clearTimeout(enemyTimer);enemyTimer=null;for(const t of animTimeouts)clearTimeout(t);animTimeouts=[]}
function current(){return save.team[battle.pIndex]}
function foe(){return battle.foe}
function hpbar(m){return `<div class="hptrack"><i style="width:${Math.max(0,100*m.hp/m.maxHp)}%"></i></div>`}

function moveForType(type,slot){const bank=MOVE_LIBRARY[type]||MOVE_LIBRARY.normal;return {...bank[slot],type};}
function skillSet(m){const p=D[m.id],t=p.type,alt=p.type2||t;return [
 {name:'Ataque Rápido',type:'normal',cat:'physical',power:16,cost:0,cd:860,kind:'dash',icon:'✹'},
 moveForType(t,'main'),
 moveForType(alt,'ult'),
 moveForType(t,'status')
];}
function skillMarkup(s,i){const color=TYPE_COLOR[s.type]||'#92d4f5',cd=(s.cd/1000).toFixed(s.cd>=1000?1:0),cat=CATEGORY_INFO[s.cat]||CATEGORY_INFO.special,pow=s.power?`${s.power} PWR`:'Status';return `<button class="skillV8 kind-${s.kind}" data-skill="${i}" style="--skillColor:${color}"><span class="skillAura"></span><span class="skillIcon">${s.icon}</span><span class="skillName"><b>${s.name}</b><small>${s.type?TYPE_NAME[s.type]:'Defesa'} · ${cat.icon} ${cat.label}</small></span><span class="skillMeta"><b>✦ ${s.cost}</b><small>${pow} · ${cd}s</small></span><span class="coolMask" id="coolMask${i}"></span><span class="coolText" id="coolText${i}"></span></button>`}
function renderSkillsGrid(m){return skillSet(m).map((s,i)=>skillMarkup(s,i)).join('')}
function bindSkillButtons(scope=document){scope.querySelectorAll('[data-skill]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=()=>useSkill(+el.dataset.skill))}
function damage(attacker,defender,type,power){let a=D[attacker.id],d=D[defender.id],mult=advantage(type||'normal',d),stab=(type===a.type||type===a.type2)?1.35:1;let ratio=(a.atk+attacker.level*1.1+25)/(d.def+defender.level*.9+25);let raw=(power/12+attacker.level*.44+2)*ratio*stab*mult*(.88+Math.random()*.23);return {hit:Math.max(0,Math.round(raw)),mult}}
function log(message){if(!battle)return;battle.log=message;const el=$('battleLog');if(el)el.textContent=message}
function startBattle(enemies,label,wild){stopTimers();cooldowns=[0,0,0,0];battle={enemies:[...enemies],foe:null,wild,label,pIndex:Math.max(0,save.team.findIndex(m=>m.hp>0)),energy:100,shield:0,log:wild?'Um Pokémon selvagem apareceu!':'Um treinador desafia você!',active:true,paused:false};battle.foe=battle.enemies.shift();if(battle.foe&&battle.foe.id<=151&&!save.seen.includes(battle.foe.id))save.seen.push(battle.foe.id);persist();overlay(`<div class="battleHeading"><div><span class="overline">${wild?'ENCONTRO NA GRAMA':'DESAFIO DOS GINÁSIOS'} · ${GYMS[Math.min(save.gym,12)].name}</span><h2>${label}</h2></div><span class="liveFlag"><span></span> COMBATE EM TEMPO REAL</span></div><div id="combatContainer"></div>`);$('modal').classList.add('combatModal');renderBattle();}
function renderBattle(){if(!battle?.active)return;const b=battle,p=current(),e=foe();$('combatContainer').innerHTML=`<div class="arenaPro" id="arenaPro"><canvas id="battleCanvas" aria-label="Arena de Pokémon em tempo real"></canvas><div class="arenaTint"></div><div class="hudPro ally"><span class="hudName" id="allyTitle">${D[p.id].name} <em>Nv.${p.level}</em></span><div class="hudTrack"><i id="allyHP" style="width:${p.hp/p.maxHp*100}%"></i></div><span class="hudNumbers" id="allyHpText">${Math.ceil(p.hp)}/${p.maxHp} PV</span></div><div class="hudPro enemy"><span class="hudName" id="enemyTitle">${D[e.id].name} <em>Nv.${e.level}</em></span><div class="hudTrack"><i id="enemyHP" style="width:${e.hp/e.maxHp*100}%"></i></div><span class="hudNumbers" id="enemyHpText">${Math.ceil(e.hp)}/${e.maxHp} PV</span></div><div class="arenaChip" id="fpsChip">60 FPS · alvo</div><div class="joyZone" id="joyZone"><div class="joyBase"><div class="joyKnob" id="joyKnob"></div></div></div><div class="crosshairHelp" id="aimTip">🎯 MIRA AUTOMÁTICA NO ADVERSÁRIO</div><button class="dodgeBtn" id="dodgeBtn" type="button">↝<small>ESQUIVA</small></button><div class="swapSheet hide" id="swapSheet"></div></div><div class="battleFooter"><div class="energyHud"><span>✦ ENERGIA <strong id="energyNumber">100</strong></span><div class="energyTrack"><i id="energyFill" style="width:100%"></i></div><span id="guardStatus">MIRA AUTOMÁTICA</span></div><div class="skillgridV8">${renderSkillsGrid(p)}</div><div class="battleActions"><button class="miniBtn" id="swapCombat">🔁 Equipe</button><button class="miniBtn" id="potionCombat">🧪 Poção <strong id="potionCount">${save.potions}</strong></button><button class="miniBtn" id="superCombat">💖 Super <strong id="superCount">${save.superPotions}</strong></button>${b.wild?`<button class="miniBtn catchButton" id="catchCombat">🔴 Capturar <strong id="ballCount">${save.balls}</strong></button>`:''}<button class="miniBtn" id="soundToggle" title="Ativar ou desativar sons">${soundEnabled?'♫ Som':'♪ Mudo'}</button></div><div class="battleMessage" id="battleLog" aria-live="polite">${b.log}</div><div class="keyHelp">PC: WASD / setas para mover · mira automática no inimigo · 1–4 golpes · ESPAÇO esquiva. Celular: joystick + golpes.</div></div>`;
 bindSkillButtons(document);$('dodgeBtn').onclick=()=>engine?.dodge();$('swapCombat').onclick=showSwap;$('potionCombat').onclick=battlePotion;$('superCombat').onclick=battleSuperPotion;let c=$('catchCombat');if(c)c.onclick=catchMon;$('soundToggle').onclick=()=>{soundEnabled=!soundEnabled;$('soundToggle').textContent=soundEnabled?'♫ Som':'♪ Mudo';playSound('select')};
 engine=new BattleEngine($('battleCanvas'));engine.start();}
function useSkill(i){if(!battle?.active||battle.paused||!engine)return;engine.useMove(i)}
function showSwap(){if(!battle?.active)return;battle.paused=true;let sheet=$('swapSheet');sheet.classList.remove('hide');sheet.innerHTML=`<div class="swapHeading"><strong>🔁 SUA EQUIPE</strong><button class="miniBtn" id="closeSwap">✕ Voltar</button></div><p class="desc">Escolha outro Pokémon para continuar lutando.</p><div class="swapgrid">${save.team.map((m,i)=>`<button data-swap="${i}" ${m.hp<=0||i===battle.pIndex?'disabled':''}>${img(m.id)}<b>${D[m.id].name}</b><small>Nv.${m.level} · ${Math.ceil(m.hp)}/${m.maxHp} PV</small></button>`).join('')}</div>`;sheet.querySelector('#closeSwap').onclick=()=>{sheet.classList.add('hide');battle.paused=false};sheet.querySelectorAll('[data-swap]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=()=>{battle.pIndex=+el.dataset.swap;battle.energy=Math.max(0,battle.energy-12);cooldowns=[0,0,0,0];sheet.classList.add('hide');battle.paused=false;engine?.switchMon();log(`Vai, ${D[current().id].name}!`);})}
function battlePotion(){if(!battle?.active||!save.potions||battle.paused)return;save.potions--;let m=current();m.hp=Math.min(m.maxHp,m.hp+Math.ceil(m.maxHp*.45));log(`${D[m.id].name} recuperou pontos de vida!`);engine?.particlesAt(engine.player.x,engine.player.y,'#79efca',32,130);playSound('heal');persist();let n=$('potionCount');if(n)n.textContent=save.potions;}
function battleSuperPotion(){if(!battle?.active||!save.superPotions||battle.paused)return;save.superPotions--;let m=current();m.hp=Math.min(m.maxHp,m.hp+Math.ceil(m.maxHp*.75));log(`${D[m.id].name} usou Superpoção!`);engine?.particlesAt(engine.player.x,engine.player.y,'#ffcafa',38,120);playSound('heal');persist();let n=$('superCount');if(n)n.textContent=save.superPotions;}
function catchMon(){if(!battle?.active||!battle.wild||!save.balls||battle.paused)return;save.balls--;const m=foe(),chance=.17+.72*(1-m.hp/m.maxHp);let n=$('ballCount');if(n)n.textContent=save.balls;if(Math.random()<chance){const caught=mon(m.id,m.level);caught.shiny=!!m.shiny;if(save.team.length<6)save.team.push(caught);else save.box.push(caught);if(caught.id<=151&&!save.caught.includes(caught.id))save.caught.push(caught.id);if(!save.seen.includes(caught.id))save.seen.push(caught.id);log(`${D[m.id].name} capturado!`);playSound('catch');persist();finishCapture(m)}else{log('Ele escapou! Enfraqueça o Pokémon antes de tentar outra Pokébola.');engine?.particlesAt(engine.enemy.x,engine.enemy.y,'#ff6b78',26,170);playSound('miss');persist()}}
function finishCapture(m){if(!battle?.active)return;battle.active=false;stopTimers();resultScreen(`🔴 ${D[m.id].name} capturado!`,`Ele entrou na ${save.team.length<=6?'sua equipe':'caixa'} no nível ${m.level}. Organize seus Pokémon antes de continuar.`,false,true)}
function nextFoe(){if(!battle?.active)return;if(battle.enemies.length){battle.foe=battle.enemies.shift();if(battle.foe?.id<=151&&!save.seen.includes(battle.foe.id))save.seen.push(battle.foe.id);persist();battle.energy=Math.min(100,battle.energy+25);engine?.newEnemy();log(`${D[foe().id].name} entrou na arena!`)}else finishBattle(true)}
function finishBattle(win){if(!battle?.active)return;battle.active=false;stopTimers();let wild=battle.wild;if(win){let oldGym=save.gym,oldStage=save.stage;if(!wild){save.wins++;save.coins+=24+oldGym*10;save.balls+=1;save.stage++;if(save.stage===v29TrainerCount(save.gym)+1){save.medals.push(save.gym);save.coins+=120;save.balls+=3;save.potions+=2;save.gym++;save.stage=0}}else save.coins+=7;let earnedCoins=wild?7:(oldStage===v29TrainerCount(oldGym)?144+oldGym*10:24+oldGym*10);let xp=wild?18:22+oldGym*12+(oldStage===v29TrainerCount(oldGym)?20:0);let evs=[];for(let m of save.team){if(m.hp<=0)continue;evs.push(...awardXP(m,xp));m.hp=Math.min(m.maxHp,m.hp+Math.ceil(m.maxHp*(wild?.12:.22)))}persist();resultScreen(wild?'⚔️ ENCONTRO VENCIDO!':oldStage===v29TrainerCount(oldGym)?'🏅 INSÍGNIA CONQUISTADA!':'⭐ TREINADOR DERROTADO!',`+${earnedCoins} moedas e +${xp} EXP para cada Pokémon apto. ${oldStage===v29TrainerCount(oldGym)?'Bônus por derrotar o líder! ':''}${evs.length?'Evolução e níveis: '+evs.join(', ')+'.':''}`,true,false)}else{save.losses++;save.coins=Math.max(0,save.coins-5);for(let m of save.team)m.hp=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(m.maxHp*.5));persist();resultScreen('💔 VOCÊ PERDEU','Sua equipe foi recuperada parcialmente. Treine na grama e tente novamente.',false,false)}}
function resultScreen(title,text,win,caught){battle=null;$('modal').classList.remove('combatModal');overlay(`<div class="result">${title}</div><p class="desc" style="text-align:center">${text}</p><div class="captureVisual">${win?'🏅':'🔴'}✨</div><button class="btn primary wide" id="nextStage">${save.gym===8?'🏆 VER CONQUISTAS':'▶ CONTINUAR A TORRE'}</button><p class="loading" style="text-align:center">Progresso salvo neste navegador.</p>`);$('nextStage').onclick=()=>{close();render()}}
let soundEnabled=false,audioCtx=null;
function playSound(kind){if(!soundEnabled)return;try{audioCtx=audioCtx||new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();let osc=audioCtx.createOscillator(),gain=audioCtx.createGain(),now=audioCtx.currentTime;osc.type=kind==='hit'?'sawtooth':kind==='dash'?'triangle':'sine';const cfg={hit:[145,70,.13],move:[420,800,.14],dash:[330,150,.11],heal:[500,870,.23],catch:[520,1040,.40],miss:[240,110,.12],select:[600,710,.08]};let [a,b,d]=cfg[kind]||cfg.move;osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(a,now);osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(50,b),now+d);gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.07,now);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,now+d);osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);osc.start(now);osc.stop(now+d)}catch{}}

const STADIUM_SKINS={"flying": "data:image/png;base64,", "water": "data:image/png;base64,", "electric": "data:image/png;base64,", "grass": "data:image/png;base64,
